sentences.text: Bimal Raut vs The State Of Jharkhand And Others on 12 August,

2024 
Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 ----
W.P.(C) No. 4797 of 2023
----
 Bimal Raut ..... Petitioner
 -- Versus --
 The State of Jharkhand and others ...... Respondents

---- 
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi

---
For the Petitioner : Mr. Rajeeva Sharma, Sr. Advocate.
 Mr. Om Prkash, Advocate  Mrs. Neetu Singh, Advocate
For the State : A.C. to Mr. M.K. Roy 05/12.08.2024 :-Mr. Rajeeva Sharma, learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is co-sharer of the land in question.

He submits that the petitioner has no knowledge of initiation of proceeding for eviction with regard to 3rd party and later on he has come to know about the proceeding he has filed a petition before the learned Commissioner for impleadment for impleading him as a necessary party however the same was rejected saying that the petitioner is not co-sharer and not related in any way.

He further submits that notification dated 25.09.2021 issued by the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Dumka whereby the petitioner along with other co-sharer has been enlisted as the owner and beneficiary in respect of lands of J.B. No. 65 of Mouza-Basukinath was sought to be acquired by the Government of Jharkhand for construction of Basukinath Ring Road.

He then submits that Notification dated 12.03.2022 was further issued by the Deputy Commissioner, Dumka under Section 93(1) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 enlisting the name of the petitioner in respect of the lands in question that was also certified by the Circle Officer,
Jarmundi contained in Annexure-3.
